import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static long[] A = new long[20];

    static long solve(int position, long number) {
        if (position == 0)
            return number == 0 ? 0 : 100000000L;
        if (number < 0)
            number = -number;
        long quotient = number / A[position];
        long optionA = solve(position - 1, number - quotient * A[position]) + quotient * position;
        long optionB = solve(position - 1, number - (quotient + 1) * A[position]) + (quotient + 1) * position;
        return Math.min(optionA, optionB);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        A[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 16; ++i)
            A[i] = A[i - 1] * 10 + 1;
        System.out.println(solve(16, n));
        sc.close();
    }
}
